items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence:
Breadcrumb is plain text:
Hợp đồng / HD-2026-0142
with no , so it does not lead back to the list. Header does show HD-2026-0142, vendor 'Công ty CP Thép Hòa Bình' and badge 'Đang hiệu lực', but key fields sit in a separate 4-tile row below it.

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: One filled blue button 'Gia hạn hợp đồng' (openModal('renewModal')) plus a secondary outlined 'In / Xuất PDF'; audit headerPrimaryActions=1. No edit or terminate action exists, but nothing competes with the primary.

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: #contactList cards: name + role, <a href="mailto:...">, <a href="tel:...">, and the first contact carries the text label 'Đầu mối chính' (the other contacts carry a responsibility label such as 'Hóa đơn & thanh toán'). The contacts tab is hidden by default.

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: Due date, amount (text-right tabular-nums, vi-VN grouping, header 'Số tiền (VND)') and status badge are all present. The order is fixed chronological M1..M6 in C.pays, so the overdue M4 sits fourth below three paid rows. There is no sort by urgency.

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: The status badge text 'Quá hạn' for M4 and 'Chưa đến hạn' for the others, plus the alert text 'Mốc thanh toán M4 đã quá hạn'. There is no countdown such as 'Due in N days', but the overdue label is text, not colour alone.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: #alertText: 'Hợp đồng hết hạn sau 70 ngày (14/01/2027)'. The KPI tile 'Hiệu lực 15/01/2026 – 14/01/2027' and the tile 'Còn lại 70 ngày' agree (the 70 days checks out from 2026-11-05).

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: The Phụ lục list (C.apps) and the renewals timeline (C.renewals) show number, absolute date and a short title or summary. Neither has an approver field, and no approved-by text appears anywhere.

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: Only two empty messages exist: 'Không tìm thấy điều khoản phù hợp.' and 'Không có mốc nào.' Neither has an action button. There is no loading state (audit loadingPlaceholders=0), no error or retry markup, and contacts, appendices and renewal have no empty state.

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: The page has no terminate action and no confirmation dialog. The only modal is renewModal, a renewal request form.

notes: Plain Tailwind slate and blue admin. Sidebar is slate-900 with a blue-600 primary and a text-only 'ProcureHub' logo. KPI tiles carry no icons or delta pills. Contact avatars are initials, but they are real people, so not a tell. The table header is uppercase without tracking, so it is not a tell. Status badges use emerald, red, amber, blue and slate, but all carry text, so only mild rainbow-status. The audit scored 90, with text-contrast failures on the grey chevrons (2.56:1). The main gaps are non-link breadcrumb, no approver on amendments, no urgency ordering, no section states (loading/error/empty actions), and no terminate flow.
